limitations: The Actions artifact digest authenticates the downloaded archive bytes against GitHub API metadata.

Original model-run artifacts are not re-downloaded here. Their local artifact-audit records, retained file hashes, source records, answers, and verdicts are cross-checked against each fresh replay receipt.

A successful fresh replay verifies the exact retained answer and native verifier result; it does not establish that the original model run's environment was free of every possible side channel beyond the recorded isolation checks.
